scope: No source edits, model/site/tokenizer requests, or raw-reference reads. Reviewed exact local source diff and boundary tests; git diff --check passed.
disposition: No blocking implementation issues found in the reviewed final patch; suitable for freezing and the authorized controlled 2x2 trial. No runtime improvement is claimed by this static review.

browser.model_selection_and_authority: Primary and one different observed alternative come from the same paid admitted request, with bounded plan/reason fields. Legacy replies create no plan. Navigation remains non-factual and does not grant review rights.
browser.stale_plan: Same query/node/identity and semantic program/contract/DAG/versions/pending/routes/issues/failed review authority are required. Future unknown material fields enter the hash conservatively. Empty-read operational changes alone do not renew/invalidate a selection.
browser.original_occurrence: Alternative URL must remain eligible; original source document must retain its hash; exact original link/label/context identity is reconstructed and compared. A newer representative of the same URL cannot supply substituted provenance.
browser.budgets: Before popping the one-use plan, current web action capacity and one ordinary source-read call beyond the audit reserve are required. Actual _visit reserves the normal web action. No new navigation model call, free repair, or budget increase is added. Failure also consumes one use.
browser.prompt: Compressed prompt retains original text as evidence, exact named subject/relation, plausible intermediate branches, empty-window limits, null as local assessment rather than frontier closure, original offsets, non-factual navigation, and no fabricated URLs/global search/reranking.
browser.found_and_resolved: Initial unhashable alternative/primary ID TypeError edge was reported and corrected with string guards; new invalid-ID tests retain the existing paid repair limit.
browser.approved_primary_gate: Primary attempted plus the controller subsequently requesting navigation; source-reading scheduling stays with the unchanged controller. The branch plan does not independently trigger navigation.

reading.source_integrity: Cards deepcopy only exact currently visible original source records and attach current requested-variable known/obligation/explicitly offered frozen references. No inferred stance/value/source/retraction target or output schema field is added.
reading.stale_projection: Existing cards are popped and rebuilt; frozen refs are recomputed from current scope rather than a retained checklist. Four reentry cases test removed sources/offers, changed requested slot and boundary scope.
reading.authority_and_state: Canonical payload, raw responses, source mapper, state, budget limits, validation and review authority remain unchanged. Prior model-judgment fact routes remain legally challengeable; immutable current-batch frozen rows remain protected.
reading.capacity: Repeated original text and added instructions are included in the production wire token count/admission path; positive and preflight-rejection tests cover this overhead.
